This model outperforms other models like Llama 2 13B and Llama 1 34B on various benchmarks. sources.snippet: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.2 is an instruction fine-tuned version of the Mistral 7B v0.2 language model. This update introduces key improvements over v0.1, including an expanded context window of 32k tokens (up from 8k), a Rope-theta value of 1e6, and the removal of Sliding-Window Attention.
